Check if the right-side driver's partial visibility makes sense geometrically or if it melts into the background.

To the right, a portion of another driver (likely a mid-range or second woofer) is visible. The enclosure has a glossy black finish with some brushed metal or silver accents on the left edge. Several small circular indentations or mounting points are visible on the baffle.
